paite: TOUPA ka hatna aw, ka hon it hi.
heading: TOUPA Sikha David La: Amah Doute Tengteng A Kipan Leh Saul Khut A Kipan TOUPA'N Ahumbit Lai A TOUPA Kiang A Agen / David Vualzohna La / (2 Sam 22.1-51)
english: For the Chief Musician. By David the servant of Yahweh, who spoke to Yahweh the words of this song in the day that Yahweh delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul. He said, I love you, Yahweh, my strength.

paite: TOUPA ka suangpi leh ka kulhpi, hon humbitpa ahi; ka Pathian ka suangpi kiptak ahi a, amah ah ginna ka koih ding; ka phaw, ka hotdamna kii leh ka insang ahi.
english: Yahweh is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my rock, in whom I take refuge; my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my high tower.

paite: Phat tuak TOUPA ka sam ding a, Hon doute lak ah hotdam in ka om ding hi.
english: I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; and I am saved from my enemies.

paite: Sihna khauhualte'n ahon gak a, Pathian limsaklouhna tuihual in hon tum a;
english: The cords of death surrounded me. The floods of ungodliness made me afraid.

paite: Sheol khauhualte'n ahon gaksuak a, sihna thangte ka kimvel in a-om hi.
english: The cords of Sheol were around me. The snares of death came on me.

paite: Ka lungkham a TOUPA ka sam a, ka Pathian ka sam hi. Ama'n atempul a pan ka aw aza a, ama a ka kikou husa abil ah alutta hi.
english: In my distress I called on Yahweh, and cried to my God. He heard my voice out of his temple. My cry before him came into his ears.

paite: Huaitak in lei aling a, akisatta aheh ziak in mualte leng akingakna nangawn toh akisat in alingta hi.
english: Then the earth shook and trembled. The foundations also of the mountains quaked and were shaken, because he was angry.

paite: Anak a kipan in meikhu azamtou a, akam a pawt mei in akang zuazua a, meihol leng akuangsak hi.
english: Smoke went out of his nostrils. Consuming fire came out of his mouth. Coals were kindled by it.

paite: Ama'n vante kunsak in, ahohsuk a; akhenuai ah mial bikbek a-om hi.
english: He bowed the heavens also, and came down. Thick darkness was under his feet.

paite: Cherub tung ah atuang a, alengta hi, ahi, huihkhuate ah aleng vengveng hi.
english: He rode on a cherub, and flew. Yes, he soared on the wings of the wind.

paite: Mial bukna mun ah, bukta in ama umna abawl a; tui a mialna leh van a meipite mah.
english: He made darkness his hiding place, his pavilion around him, darkness of waters, thick clouds of the skies.

paite: Ama a vakna ziak in ameipite atheng a, gialte leh mei-amte ake toktok uhi.
english: At the brightness before him his thick clouds passed, hailstones and coals of fire.

paite: TOUPA van tung ah aging dodop a, Tungnungpen in a-aw asuaksak a; gialte leh mei- amte ake toktok uhi.
english: Yahweh also thundered in the sky. The Most High uttered his voice: hailstones and coals of fire.

paite: Athalte akapkhia a, amaute ahihzak hi; ahi, khua aphe zolzol nilouh a, ahihbuai vengvung hi.
english: He sent out his arrows, and scattered them. He routed them with great lightning bolts.

paite: Huaitak in, TOUPA aw, na tai ding a, na nak a hu pawt in amut ziak in, tui luannate ahong kilang a, leilung kingaknate hihlat in a-omta hi.
english: Then the channels of waters appeared. The foundations of the world were laid bare at your rebuke, Yahweh, at the blast of the breath of your nostrils.

paite: Ama'n tunglam a kipan hon sawk in, ahon len a; tui tampi a kipan hon kaikhia hi.
english: He sent from on high. He took me. He drew me out of many waters.

paite: Kei galhattak lak ah hon humbit a, hon hote lak ah leng; kei a ding in ahat lo zen ngal ua.
english: He delivered me from my strong enemy, from those who hated me; for they were too mighty for me.

paite: Amau ka vangtah ni in hon sual ua, himahleh TOUPA ka ginpi pen ahi.
english: They came on me in the day of my calamity, but Yahweh was my support.

paite: Ama'n mun awngthawl ah hon pikhia a; ka tung a akipah ziak in hon humbitta ahi.
english: He brought me out also into a large place. He delivered me, because he delighted in me.

paite: TOUPA'N ka diktatdan bang in ka tung ah ahih a; ka khutte asianthoudan bang ngei in ahon din ahi.
english: Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness. According to the cleanness of my hands, he has recompensed me.

paite: TOUPA lampite ka tawn a, ka Pathian kiang a kipan giloutak in ka paimang ngei ngal kei a.
english: For I have kept the ways of Yahweh, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

paite: Avaihawmna tengteng ka ma ah a-om a, adan thusehte ka pai ngei ngal kei hi.
english: For all his ordinances were before me. I didn’t put away his statutes from me.

paite: Amah lak ah gensiatbei ka hi a, ka siatna a kipan ka kihuikhe zel hi.
english: I was also blameless with him. I kept myself from my iniquity.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA'N ka dikdan bang in ahon na dinta a, ka khutte amitmuh a asianthou bang zel in.
english: Therefore Yahweh has rewarded me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

paite: Mihehpih theitakte lak ah hehpih theitak in na kilang ding a; mihoihkimte lak ah hoihkim in na kilang ding a;
english: With the merciful you will show yourself merciful. With the perfect man, you will show yourself perfect.

paite: misiangthoute lak ah siangthou in na kilang ding a; huan, genhakte lak ah genhak in na kilang ding hi.
english: With the pure, you will show yourself pure. With the crooked you will show yourself shrewd.

paite: Gimthuak mite hondam ding na hi ngal a; mikisatheite bel na hihniam ding hi.
english: For you will save the afflicted people, but the arrogant eyes you will bring down.

paite: Nang ka khawnvak na hon detsak ding ahi ngal a. TOUPA ka Pathian in ka mialna ahihvak ding hi.
english: For you will light my lamp, Yahweh. My God will light up my darkness.

paite: Nang hon panpih in gal ka delh ngal a; ka Pathian panpih mah in kulh dai ka tawmkan ahi.
english: For by you, I advance through a troop. By my God, I leap over a wall.

paite: Pathian lampi ahoihkim a, TOUPA thu etdik ahita hi; amah a ginna koih tengteng a ding in amah tuh phaw ahi.
english: As for God, his way is perfect. Yahweh’s word is tried. He is a shield to all those who take refuge in him.

paite: TOUPA lou Pathian kua a-om a ahia? I Pathian lou suangpi kua a-om a ahia?
english: For who is God, except Yahweh? Who is a rock, besides our God,

paite: Hatna hon tengsakpa leh ka lampi hih hoihkimpa Pathian mah;
english: the God who arms me with strength, and makes my way perfect?

paite: Ama'n ka khe zukpi khe bang in abawl a, ka mun sangte ah hon omsak hi.
english: He makes my feet like deer’s feet, and sets me on my high places.

paite: Ka khutte galdou ding in achil a, ka bante'n dal thalpeu alaizou hial hi.
english: He teaches my hands to war, so that my arms bend a bow of bronze.

paite: Nang na hotdamna phaw na hon pia a, na khut taklam in ahon kai a, na kingaihniamna in na hon bawllian hi.
english: You have also given me the shield of your salvation. Your right hand sustains me. Your gentleness has made me great.

paite: Ka nuai a ka kalsuanna na hihlian a, huchi in ka khete ateu kei hi.
english: You have enlarged my steps under me, My feet have not slipped.

paite: Hon doute ka delh ding a, ka delhpha ding; hihmanthat a a-om masiah uh ka kihei kikta kei ding hi.
english: I will pursue my enemies, and overtake them. I won’t turn away until they are consumed.

paite: Athohnawn theihlouhna ding un ka sattan ding a, ka khenuai ah apuk ding uh.
english: I will strike them through, so that they will not be able to rise. They shall fall under my feet.

paite: Nang kidouna a ding in hatna ka tai ah na hon tengsak a, hon sualte ka nuai ah na zouta hi.
english: For you have armed me with strength to the battle. You have subdued under me those who rose up against me.

paite: Hon hote ka hihmanthat theihna ding in, nang hon doute hon nunglehngatsan ding in na omsakta hi.
english: You have also made my enemies turn their backs to me, that I might cut off those who hate me.

paite: Amau akikou ua, himahleh hondampa ding kuamah a-om kei uh; TOUPA asam ua, himahleh adawng tuan kei hi.
english: They cried, but there was no one to save; even to Yahweh, but he didn’t answer them.

paite: Huaitak in leivui huih mutleng bang in ka satnen a, kholak buannawi bang phet in ka paikheta hi.
english: Then I beat them small as the dust before the wind. I cast them out as the mire of the streets.

paite: Nang mite kilaina lak ah na hon humbit a; namte lutang ding in na hon siam a, ka theih ngei louh mite'n ka nek-tak abawlta ding uhi.
english: You have delivered me from the strivings of the people. You have made me the head of the nations. A people whom I have not known shall serve me.

paite: Ka tanchin azaktak un ka thu amang ding ua; mikhualte ka kiang ah akipe ding uhi.
english: As soon as they hear of me they shall obey me. The foreigners shall submit themselves to me.

paite: Mikhualte avul ding ua, a-insang ua kipan in ling kawm in ahong suk ding uhi.
english: The foreigners shall fade away, and shall come trembling out of their strongholds.

paite: TOUPA ahing hi; ka suangpi phat in om henla; hon hondampa Pathian pahtawi in om hen.
english: Yahweh lives! Blessed be my rock. Exalted be the God of my salvation,

paite: Phu hon laksakpa leh ka nuai a mite koihpa Pathian ahi.
english: even the God who executes vengeance for me, and subdues peoples under me.

paite: Ama'n hon doute lak ah hon honkhia a, ahi, nang kei hon sualte tunglam ah na hon domkang a; mihiamgamte lak a kipan na hon humbit zel hi.
english: He rescues me from my enemies. Yes, you lift me up above those who rise up against me. You deliver me from the violent man.

paite: Huaiziak in TOUPA aw, namte lak ah kipahthu ka hon hilh ding a, nang phat in la ka sa ding hi.
english: Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.

paite: Ama'n hotdamna thupitak akumpipa kiang ah ape zel a; athaunilhpa tung ah, David leh asuante tung ngei ah, tangtawn in azahngaihna alangsak ding hi.
english: He gives great deliverance to his king, and shows loving kindness to his anointed, to David and to his offspring, forever more.
